At some point during the construction of [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] on the planet [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] sent a team of rebels on a '''mission''' to steal a [[DSS-02 shield generator/Legends|DSS-02 shield generator]] in order to create a deflector shield that would protect the rebel base on Hoth.<ref name="Rebel Heist" />
